XCEW PROCESSOR FLOORPLAN VISUALIZATION
=====================================

Die Size: 4.2mm x 4.2mm (17.64mm², under 18mm² target)

└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

POWER DOMAINS:
- Core/EML Domain (1.2V): Top-left quadrant, houses RISC-V core, EML units, AXI interconnect
- SNN Domain (0.9V): Center-right strip, voltage-island for power gating, contains SNN tiles
- NVM Domain (1.8V): Bottom-right quadrant, always-on for non-volatile storage

MACRO PLACEMENT:
- SRAM Macros: Within Core/EML region for EML unit
- SNN Memories: In dedicated SNN voltage island
- NVM Arrays: In dedicated 1.8V domain with ECC and wear-leveling circuitry

FLOORPLAN CONSTRAINTS:
- Total area: 4.2mm x 4.2mm = 17.64mm² (under 18mm² target)
- Core utilization: ~45% to allow routing congestion
- Power domains: Physically separated with guard rings
- Clock domains: 250MHz (core) and 125MHz (SNN) with isolated clock trees
- IO ring: Surrounds the core area with proper ESD protection

PHYSICAL IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
- IO buffers placed in 1.8V domain for maximum compatibility
- Power pads distributed to minimize IR drop
- Ground mesh spanning all domains for low impedance return path
- ESD protection devices integrated in IO ring
- Corner placement for alignment marks and seal ring

The floorplan efficiently partitions the die into three power domains while maintaining good area utilization under the 18mm² constraint.
